purpose: bounded primary-literature sweep for journal-published merit values attached to the frozen public generating vectors
frozen_vector_targets: the same UNSW lattice-29102 fixed-rule family for N=2^10 through 2^20
the corresponding UNSW lattice-39102 extensible family only when a paper explicitly identifies it

Component-by-component constructions achieve the optimal rate of convergence for multivariate integration in weighted Korobov and Sobolev spaces

LatticeBuilder: A General Software Tool for Constructing Rank-1 Lattice Rules

inspection_fields: does the paper print a numerical merit or worst-case-error value
does the value identify a complete vector or a frozen public vector family
are N, dimension, weights, kernel, normalization, and displayed precision recoverable
does the value qualify for prospective classification or only contextual evidence
admission_rule: classification revives only for a printed numerical merit tied unambiguously to a frozen vector with recoverable normalization and weights
exclusions: theoretical rate bounds without a vector-specific numerical value
vectors generated only inside an example and not identified with the frozen public distribution
theses, manuals, websites, later citing papers, and papers outside the six-item perimeter
stop_rule: after all six paper bodies and relevant tables are checked, do not expand the perimeter without a new timestamped amendment
